steps.title: An A minor shape
steps.body:
Am is the short written name for A minor: A, C and E. Use open string 5, fret 2 on strings 4 and 3, fret 1 on string 2, and open string 1. The x over string 6 means do not play it in this shape.

**Why it matters:** Choosing which strings to leave out is part of learning a shape; you do not always play all six.

steps.title: Read and hear the notes
steps.body: Read the diagram from thick string 6 on the left to thin string 1 on the right. Leave string 6 out and start from string 5. The open A supplies the root.

items.prompt: Play A, E, A, C, E together. Use any positions for these notes.

steps.title: Make it familiar
steps.body: Clear the app selection with Escape, then build Am slowly. Check each pressed string separately on your guitar before sounding the group.

items.prompt: Play A, E, A, C, E together. Use any positions for these notes.
